purpose: Exploratory follow-up validation on fresh source threads, not formal preregistered causal study
exclusions: No reused thread or known same incident; label possible same-account or incident overlap. Search cache and relative times remain uncertain.
target: 15-25 narrative units from new threads/documents, positive/neutral/negative and rival explanations

hypotheses.prediction: Service certainty separates permission/coverage, confirmed scheduling and physical parts availability
hypotheses.support: Accounts explicitly distinguish at least two stages
hypotheses.rival: A straightforward single-stage booking consistently resolves the need
hypotheses.reject_or_limit: No distinction in fresh accounts, or confusion is solely mechanical defect without information/handoff concern

hypotheses.prediction: Service records matter as decision evidence but dealer exclusivity of records is contested
hypotheses.support: Fresh buyer/owner accounts use history or receipts for condition/resale
hypotheses.rival: Vehicle inspection, price or relationship dominates and record provenance is irrelevant
hypotheses.reject_or_limit: Fresh accounts show no record concern or show official-dealer trail required in a narrowly specified transaction

hypotheses.prediction: Free-service/warranty labels can leave parts, exclusions and counterparty responsibilities unresolved
hypotheses.support: Fresh narratives contrast promise with a particular condition or responsibility
hypotheses.rival: Stated terms are clear; outcome is preference or a covered/uncovered accident case rather than communication failure
hypotheses.reject_or_limit: Fresh sources show clear understood conditions and satisfactory service

hypotheses.prediction: Powertrain choice remains conditional on purchase budget and actual usage, not general EV attitude
hypotheses.support: Fresh shoppers change consideration due budget, use or charging context
hypotheses.rival: Strong product preference remains despite those constraints or EV economics dominate for low-mileage buyers
hypotheses.reject_or_limit: No context-specific tradeoff or actual choice observed

analysis: Source-grounded manual coding; record supports/mixed/contradicts/not_informative per hypothesis. No population pvalues, no causal effect claims. Search deliberately spans competing terms and favorable accounts.
